name: Iri Dam
source:
'It's your birthday, Unnie! Let's have a festival!"

Next-generation track and field ace.

A junior who has admired and followed the protagonist since they were in the same baseball team in middle school. Although she was short and frail back then, she grew astonishingly during the year they were apart, becoming a tall 180cm girl. Her limbs grew long and slender, changing her appearance to look almost like a model, but she follows and admires protagonist just as she did in middle school. The protagonist also finds Iri extremely adorable.
